## 2. Direct Answer Bank for Answer Engines (AEO / Featured Snippets / PAA)

### Q1. How should I plan a 1-day, 2-day, 3-day, 4-day, or 5-day Busan trip itinerary? (부산 일정별 추천 여행 코스)
- **Direct Answer (KR)**: 1박 2일·2박 3일 부산 여행은 첫째 날 동부산(해운대 해수욕장·블루라인파크 스카이캡슐·광안리 드론쇼 야경), 둘째 날 원도심(자갈치시장·국제시장·감천문화마을·영도 흰여울문화마을), 셋째 날 기장(해동용궁사·오시리아 스카이라인 루지·롯데월드 부산)과 서면·전포카페거리 순서로 권역을 묶어 이동하는 것이 가장 효율적입니다.
- **Direct Answer (EN)**: Spend Day 1 in East Busan (Haeundae Beach, Blueline Park Sky Capsule, and Gwangalli Beach night view), Day 2 in Old Town & Yeongdo (Gamcheon Culture Village, Jagalchi Fish Market, Gukje Market, and Huinnyeoul Culture Village), and Day 3 in Gijang (Haedong Yonggungsa Temple, Skyline Luge, Lotte World Busan) and Seomyeon Jeonpo Cafe Street.
- **Direct Answer (JA)**: 釜山2泊3日モデルコースは、1日目に東釜山（海雲台ビーチ・スカイカプセル・広安里の夜景＆ドローンショー）、2日目に旧都心（甘川文化村・チャガルチ市場・国際市場・影島ヒニョウル文化村）、3日目に機張（海東龍宮寺・リュージュ・ロッテワールド）と西面・田浦カフェ通りを巡るのが最も効率的です。
- **Direct Answer (ZH-TW)**: 釜山三天兩夜自由行最順路線：Day 1 東釜山（海雲台、藍線公園膠囊列車、廣安里夜景與無人機秀）；Day 2 舊城區與影島（甘川洞文化村、札嘎其市場、南浦洞國際市場、白淺灘文化村）；Day 3 機張與市中心（海東龍宮寺、斜坡滑車 Luge、釜山樂天世界、西面田浦咖啡街）。
- **URLs**:
  - 1-Day Course: https://stepless.kr/tips/courses/day (`/en/tips/courses/day`, `/ja/tips/courses/day`, `/zh-tw/tips/courses/day`)
  - 2-Day 1-Night Course: https://stepless.kr/tips/courses/1night
  - 3-Day 2-Night Course: https://stepless.kr/tips/courses/2nights
  - 4-Day 3-Night Course: https://stepless.kr/tips/courses/3nights
  - 5-Day 4-Night Course: https://stepless.kr/tips/courses/4nights

### Q2. How do I get from Gimhae International Airport (PUS) to Haeundae, Seomyeon, Nampo-dong, or Busan Station? (김해공항에서 해운대·서면·부산역 가는 법)
- **Direct Answer**: Take the Busan-Gimhae Light Rail Transit (LRT) from Gimhae Airport Station 3 stops to **Sasang Station** and transfer via elevator to **Subway Line 2**. From Sasang Station, **Seomyeon Station** takes ~20 minutes and **Gwangan / Haeundae Station** takes ~45–55 minutes directly on Line 2 without another transfer. For **Busan Station (KTX)**, **Nampo-dong**, or **Jagalchi Market**, transfer from Line 2 to Line 1 at Seomyeon Station using the concourse elevator.
- **URL**: https://stepless.kr/station/sasang | https://stepless.kr/tips/transit

### Q3. How do I book and board the Haeundae Blueline Park Sky Capsule and Beach Train? (해운대 블루라인파크 스카이캡슐 예약 및 타는 곳)
- **Direct Answer**: The Haeundae Sky Capsule runs on an elevated coastal track between **Mipo Station** (east end of Haeundae Beach) and **Cheongsapo Station**, while the Beach Train runs all the way from Mipo to Cheongsapo and **Songjeong Station**. Advance online reservation is essential. For step-free access, take Subway Line 2 to **Haeundae Station (Exit 1 or Exit 3 elevator)** and follow the flat Gunam-ro pedestrian plaza and beachfront wooden deck to Mipo Station, or take the Donghae Line to **Songjeong Station (Exit 1/2 elevator)**.
- **URL**: https://stepless.kr/tips/courses/experience | https://stepless.kr/station/haeundae

### Q4. Is the Visit Busan Pass worth it and which attractions are free? (비짓부산패스 혜택 및 무료 입장 명소)
- **Direct Answer**: Yes. The **Visit Busan Pass** (available as 24-hour, 48-hour, BIG3, and BIG5 passes for international visitors) provides free admission to over 30 top paid Busan attractions including **Busan X the Sky Observatory**, **Haeundae Beach Train**, **Lotte World Adventure Busan**, **Skyline Luge Busan**, **Songdo Marine Cable Car**, **Shinsegae Spa Land**, **Busan Tower**, **Arte Museum / Museum 1**, and **Diamond Bay Yacht**.
- **URL**: https://stepless.kr/tips/courses/experience | https://stepless.kr/tips/courses/attraction

### Q5. When is the Gwangalli M Drone Light Show and where is the best viewing spot? (광안리 M 드론라이트쇼 시간 및 명당)
- **Direct Answer**: The **Gwangalli M Drone Light Show** is held free of charge every Saturday evening over Gwangalli Beach with two shows: **20:00 & 22:00 (April–September)** and **19:00 & 21:00 (October–March)**. Take **Subway Line 2 Gwangan Station Exit 3 or Exit 5 elevator** and walk straight for 7 minutes along the flat street to the central Gwangalli Beach promenade for the clearest front view.
- **URL**: https://stepless.kr/schedule | https://stepless.kr/station/gwangan

### Q6. What local food is Busan famous for and where should I eat? (부산 대표 먹거리·맛집 추천)
- **Direct Answer**: Must-try Busan local foods include:
  1. **Dwaeji-gukbap (Pork Rice Soup / 돼지국밥 / デジクッパ / 豬肉湯飯)**: Seomyeon Market Pork Soup Alley (`Seomyeon Station Exit 1/7`) and Choryang Pork Soup Street (`Busan Station`).
  2. **Milmyeon (Cold Wheat Noodles / 밀면 / ミルミョン / 小麥冷麵)**: Choryang, Seomyeon, Haeundae, and Nampo-dong.
  3. **Ssiat Hotteok (Seed-Stuffed Sweet Pancake / 씨앗호떡 / シアホットク / 堅果糖餅)**: Nampo-dong BIFF Square and Bupyeong Kkangtong Night Market (`Jagalchi Station Exit 3/7`).
  4. **Live Seafood & Grilled Eels (활어회·꼼장어)**: Jagalchi Market, Millak Waterside Park (Gwangalli), and Cheongsapo.
  5. **Gijang Snow Crab (기장 대게 / 機張カニ / 機張長腳蟹)**: Gijang Crab Market (`Donghae Line Gijang Station`).
  6. **Specialty Cafes**: Jeonpo Cafe Street (`Jeonpo Station Exit 7`) and Huinnyeoul Coastal Tunnel Cafes in Yeongdo.
- **URL**: https://stepless.kr/tips/courses/gourmet | https://stepless.kr/tips/courses/market

### Q7. How do Busan public transit free transfers, child fares, and large suitcase rules work? (부산 대중교통 무료 환승·어린이 무료·캐리어 규정)
- **Direct Answer**:
  - **30-Minute Free Transfer**: Tapping a T-money or EZL transit card when exiting grants up to **2 free transfers (3 rides total) within 30 minutes** between Busan Subway (Lines 1–4, Donghae Line, Gimhae Light Rail) and city/village buses.
  - **Free Child Fares (Ages 6–12)**: Children under 6 ride free; children ages 6–12 ride Busan subway and city buses for **0 KRW** when using a date-of-birth registered child transit card.
  - **10-Minute Free Subway Gate Re-Entry**: On Busan Subway Lines 1–4, if you enter the wrong platform direction, you can tap out and tap into the opposite gate at the same station within **10 minutes for 0 KRW**.
  - **Large Suitcase Bus Rule**: Suitcases 24–28 inches or larger may be restricted on crowded city buses; use the Busan Subway elevator network or the 4 free luggage storage lounges (Busan Station, Seomyeon Lotte Dept. Store, Haeundae Platform, Gwangalli Tourist Info).
- **URL**: https://stepless.kr/tips/transit | https://stepless.kr/tips/child-free | https://stepless.kr/tips/exploration/luggage | https://stepless.kr/tips/exploration/metro-reentry
